name: Three-Way Melee
description: Three rivals, one city, one prize. Metropolis is the densest market on the map and every company wants the soft-drink aisle. Become the best-known brand, hold a commanding share, and prove it is no fluke by stringing together a year of profits.

goals.description: Reach 75 brand awareness for soft drinks in Metropolis — top of mind in a four-way fight.
Sell 40% of the soft drinks bought in Metropolis over three months — a clear plurality in a four-company race.
Post 12 consecutive months of positive net income (after depreciation, interest and tax).
Grow company value to $140M — spoils worthy of winning the melee.
